summary: 不与团队合作，只有死路一条！在这款最富挑战性的团队向射击游戏中，你可以为恢复伦敦和平而战，也可以大肆破坏、从中牟取暴利！
summaryEn: Work together or die alone! Fight to restore peace to London or tear it down for profit in the most challenging team based shooter around.
